text:
zoe: Marine layer rolled in like it owns the place. Ferry status says limited service. Anyone rerouting?

nate: Switched to the shuttle app. ETA looks like +18. Considering singing loudly to drown out the fog. :microphone:

rina: Im already late thanks to a very committed puddle at my corner. If someone needs a dry seat I have one on the shuttle (small but noble).

oliver: Took the bridge stairs two at a time. Regretting life choices at step 47. Also: if you see a person wearing flip-flops, offer them socks.

commute-bot: Ferry Authority: "Limited ferry service due to low visibility. Check updates before travel: https://status.bayferry.example"

weather-bot: Weather: "Marine layer: heavy coastal fog / visibility < 0.3mi. Wind light. Temperatures 53-58F."

zoe: Quick poll: who wants a coffee meetup near the shuttle stop? React with :thumbsup: for yes.

nate: :thumbsup: I will accept coffee in any physical form.

rina: :thumbsup: yes please, my shoes are audibly sloshing.

oliver: no reaction = I will trade you a granola bar for the coffee.

zoe: Meeting point: bus shelter by the mural (next to the koi statue). If fog eats the mural, follow my voice.

commute-bot: Shuttle capacity 18. Current shuttle ETA 14m.

nate: On my way. If fog karaoke happens on the shuttle we have rules: 1) no requests from the office playlist, 2) mandatory chorus, 3) bring tissues.

rina: I volunteer as backup chorus and towel. Also, @oliver there will be socks at work storage.

zoe: See yll at the koi. Bring jackets and heroic attitudes. :wave:
